missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Коридор' is a masculine noun in the nominative as the subject. 'Этот' points at a specific one, and 'длинный' is the agreeing masculine adjective. A simple description.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Коридор' is the accusative direct object of 'мою'; for this inanimate masculine noun the accusative equals the nominative. 'Каждую субботу' is an accusative time phrase.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Коридора' is the genitive form of 'коридор' after 'в конце', meaning at the end of the corridor. 'Окно' is the nominative subject. A spatial locating phrase.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'по'. 'Коридору' is the dative form of 'коридор' after 'по', meaning movement along the corridor. 'Уборщица' is the nominative subject. A common motion pattern.

Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Коридоре' is the prepositional form of 'коридор' after 'в', locating the mirror in the corridor. 'Зеркало' is the nominative subject. A core location pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'над'. 'Коридором' is the instrumental form of 'коридор' after 'над', locating the ceiling above the corridor. 'Тёмный потолок' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'к'. 'Коридору' is the dative form of 'коридор' after 'к', marking the goal of motion. 'Длинному' agrees in the masculine dative. 'Дети' is the plural subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'из'. 'Коридора' is the genitive form of 'коридор' after 'из', marking the source. 'Холодный ветер' is the nominative subject. A vivid everyday sentence.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Коридоры' is the nominative plural of 'коридор', the subject. 'Длинные' and 'белые' are agreeing plural adjectives. 'В больнице' uses the prepositional 'больнице'.
Strategic focus: Dative plural after 'по'. 'Коридорам' is the dative plural of 'коридор' after 'по', meaning through the corridors. 'Тёмным' agrees in the dative plural. Spatial plural motion.
